variants.description: Employee selection table with bulk actions. Features select all checkbox, individual row selection, animated bulk action button, and row highlighting on selection.

variants.name: Sortable Table
variants.description: Employee directory table with interactive column sorting. Click any column header to sort data. Supports alphabetical, numeric, and custom data sorting with visual feedback.

variants.name: Striped Table
variants.description: Recruitment pipeline table with alternating row colors for improved readability. Features candidate photos, match scores with progress bars, and application status badges.

variants.name: User Management Table
variants.description: Professional admin table for managing users with avatars, role icons, department assignments, online status indicators, and action menus. Includes sidebar navigation for admin dashboard context.

families.name: Tabs
families.description: Complete tab component family with 15 production-ready variants covering documentation, dashboards, settings, mobile navigation, and animated indicators

variants.name: Basic Tabs
variants.description: Clean documentation tabs with an underline indicator. Ideal for organizing reference material, docs pages, and onboarding steps into focused sections.

variants.name: Underline Tabs
variants.description: Modern developer documentation tabs with a moving underline indicator, version badge, and embedded code samples. Built for docs sites and API references.

variants.name: Pill Tabs
variants.description: SaaS dashboard pill tabs with count badges for customer segments. Filled active pill, outlined inactive pills, and a contextual action toolbar.

variants.name: Icon Tabs
variants.description: Settings tabs with prominent icons in a responsive grid. Active tab highlights its icon container. Great for account, security, and billing configuration.

variants.name: Vertical Tabs
variants.description: Documentation sidebar with vertical tabs controlling article content. Collapses to a horizontal scroll on mobile. Ideal for docs sites and onboarding flows.

variants.name: Dashboard Tabs
variants.description: Analytics dashboard tabs switching metric panels (revenue, traffic, conversion, audience). Includes KPI cards, trend deltas, and a simple bar chart.

variants.name: Settings Tabs
variants.description: Full settings page with a vertical nav tab list and content panels including general, account, appearance, integrations, and a danger zone.

variants.name: Scrollable Tabs
variants.description: Horizontal scrollable category tabs with fade edges and hidden scrollbar for mobile marketplaces. Active tab auto-scrolls into view. Built for many categories on small screens.

variants.name: Segmented Tabs
variants.description: iOS-style segmented control with a sliding indicator that animates between segments. Used for switching time ranges and compact view modes.

variants.name: Animated Tabs
variants.description: Tabs with a smoothly animating sliding underline indicator that glides between active tabs. Great for project management workspaces with board, timeline, calendar, and files views.

variants.name: Card Tabs
variants.description: Card switching interface where each tab is a selectable pricing card with a radio-style indicator. Selecting a card reveals its feature panel. Ideal for plan pickers.

variants.name: Minimal Tabs
variants.description: Ultra-clean minimal inbox tabs with a thin sliding indicator, count annotations, and a search action. Designed for distraction-free content like email and notes apps.

variants.name: Rounded Tabs
variants.description: Soft rounded navigation tabs with a gradient active state, set in a pill container. Suited to music and media apps browsing playlists, artists, albums, and podcasts.

variants.name: Bordered Tabs
variants.description: Bordered enterprise tab set with a connected content panel, status badges, and data tables. Designed for dense operational dashboards like order and inventory management.

variants.name: Mobile Tabs
variants.description: Bottom mobile tab navigation bar with icons, labels, and a notification badge. Switches app screens within a phone-style frame. Built for native-feeling mobile web apps.

families.name: Toasts
families.description: Complete toast notification family with 6 production-ready variants covering every feedback use case from basic auto-dismiss to persistent progress and stacked queues

variants.name: Basic Toast
variants.description: Auto-dismissing success toast with icon, message, and close button

variants.name: Status Toasts
variants.description: Four semantic toast variants - success, error, warning, info - each with matching icon, color, and ARIA role

variants.name: Action Toast
variants.description: Toast with an inline action button (Undo). Fires a callback on action, or auto-dismisses if ignored

variants.name: Stacked Toasts
variants.description: Notification queue that stacks incoming toasts vertically with a staggered slide-in and dismiss-all control

variants.name: Persistent Toast
variants.description: Toast that stays open until dismissed, with a shrinking countdown progress bar that pauses on hover

variants.name: Minimal Toast
variants.description: Compact pill-shaped toast for terse icon-led feedback like Copied or Saved, centered at the bottom

families.name: Tooltips
families.description: Complete tooltip component family with 6 production-ready variants covering every use case from basic hover hints to directional positioning, rich help content, delayed reveal, icon-button labeling, and status indicators. Pure CSS - no JavaScript.

variants.name: Basic Tooltip
variants.description: Top-positioned tooltip with arrow that appears on hover and keyboard focus, pure CSS via the data-tooltip attribute

variants.name: Directional Tooltip
variants.description: Tooltips in all four directions - top, right, bottom, left - with arrows that reposition automatically via the data-tooltip-pos attribute

variants.name: Rich Tooltip
variants.description: Wide tooltip with rich content - a title plus a multi-line description - ideal for help text on form fields and complex UI elements

variants.name: Delayed Tooltip
variants.description: Tooltip that waits 600ms before appearing on hover so quick mouse-overs don't flicker, then hides instantly on exit via CSS transition-delay

variants.name: Icon Tooltip
variants.description: Tooltip on an icon-only button - the key accessibility use case where the tooltip serves as the visible label with aria-label and role=tooltip

variants.name: Status Tooltip
variants.description: Status indicator dot with a color-themed tooltip - success, warning, error, info - where the tooltip background and arrow match the semantic status

families.name: AI Chat Interface

variants.name: AI Chat Interface — Neo-Brutalism

variants.name: AI Chat Interface — Vercel
variants.description: Refined dark monochrome AI chat surface with hairline borders, a subtle conic glow, a glowing ready-state dot, a streaming typing indicator, prompt chips, and a minimal input bar. Generous spacing and a single teal accent echo a premium dev-tool aesthetic.
